brand.taglineShort: Add up every subscription — then cut what fails the math.

methodology: We annualize every price as monthly × 12 unless a documented annual plan is cheaper.
Trial offers include renewal date, cancel URL, and whether a card is required at signup.
Amazon bounty claims link only to official Associates bounty landing pages.
SaaS affiliate picks require a published commission rate and cookie window before we recommend.
We re-check list prices quarterly on featured stacks.
Reader corrections are answered within 72 hours with dated amendment notes.

about.headline: Why SubAudit exists
about.body: We built SubAudit after a single credit-card export showed twelve overlapping subscriptions — three streaming add-ons, two AI tools, and four Amazon auto-ships we forgot existed. We publish annualized math, trial fine print, and cancellation steps so you cut spend without guessing which login page to find.
